definitions.state_iteration_zero: initial encoder output before any recurrent step
definitions.target_probability: softmax probability of the answer digit
definitions.margin: answer logit minus the largest competing logit
definitions.basis_fit: alternating complete puzzles within each rating bucket
definitions.state_rotation_centering: subtract the endpoint chord separately within each phase
definitions.update_rotation_centering: subtract each cell's temporal mean after projection
definitions.predictive_state_input: raw or token-unit state projected into a basis fitted on train-puzzle chord residuals; the intercept and slope are fitted only on the calibration prefix
definitions.transition_probe_geometry: u[t-1] and its geometry, available at h[t], for predicting correctness at t+1; t=0 is excluded
